fixture_notice: All repositories, branches, issue keys, and scenarios are fictional.

cases.query: Stage only the tenant-export changes, commit them, push my branch, and open a draft GitHub pull request.
cases.reason: The request spans the full staged delivery workflow.

cases.query: Create a commit from the already staged files, but show me the exact message and scope first.
cases.reason: Commit-only delivery is explicitly supported.

cases.query: Push the current branch to origin and set its upstream after confirming the exact ref.
cases.reason: A push-only request still needs the delivery safety gate.

cases.query: Open GitLab MR !new from feature/retention to main using the repository template; don't create missing labels.
cases.reason: GitLab MR creation with provider conventions is supported.

cases.query: My worktree also has unrelated notes. Commit only src/export and its tests, then publish that branch.
cases.reason: Mixed-worktree staging classification is a core safety behavior.

cases.query: The remote branch was rewritten. Propose a force-with-lease push, show the exact branch, and wait for a separate confirmation.
cases.reason: Explicit force mode belongs to the guarded push workflow.

cases.query: 把当前修改提交并推送到 GitHub，然后创建草稿 PR；每一步都先给我确认。
cases.reason: The Chinese request clearly asks for gated Git delivery.

cases.query: 只提交已经暂存的文件，先根据 diff 给我三个符合仓库规范的 commit message。
cases.reason: Commit message proposal and staged-scope confirmation are supported.

cases.query: ship this branch pls—commit what belongs to NORTH-218, push it, then make an MR
cases.reason: Casual language still requests staged Git and MR delivery.

cases.query: Create a PR from the branch I already pushed, with these reviewers and existing labels, after showing the full proposal.
cases.reason: PR-only creation remains part of the delivery workflow.

cases.query: Review pull request 42 for correctness and missing tests, but don't change anything.
cases.reason: Read-only code review belongs to pr-mr-review.

cases.query: Pull the latest default branch for every repository under ./services.
cases.reason: Multi-repository synchronization is outside scoped change delivery.

cases.query: Implement the approved export feature across the API, worker, and migration.
cases.reason: Implementation belongs to deep-build until delivery is explicitly requested.

cases.query: Reset this branch hard to origin/main and discard all local changes.
cases.reason: Destructive history/worktree recovery is not ordinary delivery.

cases.query: Post this review comment and approve the PR.
cases.reason: Review-provider mutations are not commit/push/PR creation.

cases.query: Show git status, current branch, and remotes. Make no changes.
cases.reason: A read-only Git inspection does not need the delivery workflow.

cases.query: 发布一个新版本并创建 GitHub Release。
cases.reason: Release publication is outside commit/push/PR delivery.

cases.query: 部署当前分支到测试环境。
cases.reason: Deployment is an environment/release operation, not Git delivery.

cases.query: Create a Jira issue describing this bug and assign it to the backend team.
cases.reason: Issue creation is not Git change delivery.

cases.query: Scan the branch for vulnerable Composer and npm dependencies before deciding what to commit.
cases.reason: Dependency security analysis belongs to repository-vulnerabilities.
